Subject: Next steps: stakeholder map and contract path for NovaCare pilot

Hi Alicia & Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align internal stakeholders and unblock procurement/legal: 

1) What we heard (decision criteria):
- Performance at <200ms median latency for key endpoints
- Data residency and audit logs for PHI-related flows
- Predictable unit economics for pilot (target cost per inference)
- Integration cadence: 4-week pilot with production-like traffic profile

2) Proposed stakeholder map (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Tom Green (confirmed on call)
- Security reviewer: Mei Chen (security architect) — Alicia to confirm
- Procurement / contract owner: Rahul Singh — Alicia to confirm procurement lead for PO/PO approval cadence

3) Contract path & sequence we recommend:
- NDA (mutual) — get signed first, minimal redlines; goal: 48–72 hours
- Pilot SOW (scope + success criteria) — attach draft; review in parallel with NDA
- DPA (data processing) — security-driven; can be reviewed concurrently with MSA
- MSA (standard terms) — expect 7–10 business days for first pass redlines from legal

4) Redwood owners and SLAs for routing:
- Sales & deal lead: Ben Carter (primary signer and pricing owner)
- Security technical lead: Soojin Lee (will triage DPA/KBA requests)
- Implementation/PS touchpoint: Jordan Blake (pilot onboarding and scope)

Attachments: NDA-template-v2.pdf (redlined example), pilot-scope-draft.docx (SOW draft). I uploaded both to the Drive link above.

Request: can you /Tom confirm the security & procurement contacts by EOD tomorrow? If confirmed, Ben and Soojin will kick off the internal handoff and we’ll send the NDA for signature the same day.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

My recommended sequence and owner actions: 
- Day 0: Send mutual NDA to Alicia/Mei/Rahul for signature. Ben to approve pricing and signatory name. Goal = e-sign same day.

Turn-time assumptions (preliminary): NDA 1–3 business days; DPA 3–7 business days; MSA 7–12 business days depending on redlines. Procurement PO lead time: 7–14 business days after MSA agreement.

I attached the two templates Alicia already has (NDA-template-v2.pdf, pilot-scope-draft.docx). I’ll prepare a one-pager for legal that flags our standard fallbacks and a proposed pilot waiver if full MSA timing blocks pilot start.
